name: embertrail
description: Embertrail / Glutpfad — solo offline browser CRPG (Cinderreach)

scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @embertrail/server" "npm run dev -w @embertrail/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @embertrail/shared && npm run build -w @embertrail/rules && npm run build -w @embertrail/content && npm run build -w @embertrail/client
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @embertrail/shared && npm run build -w @embertrail/rules && npm run build -w @embertrail/content && npm run build -w @embertrail/server && npm run build -w @embertrail/client
